# SQL Server Migration Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Database > SQL Server

## Overview

Plans and executes SQL Server migrations including version upgrades, cloud migration to Azure SQL, and cross-platform conversions

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [sqlserver-migration-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
sqlserver-migration-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@sqlserver-migration-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Plan version upgrades with compatibility assessment
- Migrate to Azure SQL with DMA and DMS
- Handle compatibility level and feature changes
- Convert schemas from other RDBMS platforms

## Technology Standards Applied

- **DMA**: Data Migration Assistant for assessment
- **Azure DMS**: Database Migration Service for Azure SQL
- **Compatibility**: Compatibility level management and features
